Dr. Golap Sarma Boruah
Principal
Principal's Message
Privileged and honoured to welcome you all from the core of my heart to NAAC re-accredited Lakhimpur Kendriya Mahavidyalay(L.K.M.) that offers Higher Secondary and Degree Courses in all existing designs of courses in Assam. Annual (H.S.) Semester System, CBCS and Distance & Open Learning Education in Degree classes (in Arts Stream).
Read more
About Lakhimpur Kendriya Mahavidyalaya
Lakhimpur Kendriya Mahavidyalaya, a pioneer higher educational institution in the region, was established in 1992. On strong demand from all sections of society, precipitated by genuine necessity, the selfless, untiring efforts of devoted well-wishers and educationists led to the establishment of this institution. In the passage of time, the college was brought under the deficit system of grant-in-aid in 1998, followed by the Registration under section 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act, 1956 in 2000, and finally, the college was brought under Assam College Employees (Provincialization) Act in 2005.
			This dynamic college also took the leading role in clustering seven rural-based colleges of this region (namely RC 7) not only to exchange views and ideas in academic fields but also to work as a force to impart and enrich knowledge in higher education and enlighten the region.
